title: UN Human Rights Voting Records — CHR · HRC · GA Third Committee
description: Complete harvest of the OHCHR Search Library "Voting" collection — roll-call and summary voting records of the UN Commission on Human Rights (1946–2006) and the Human Rights Council (2006–present) — parsed from customised MARC21 cataloguing into dashboard-ready CSVs, with a self-contained, zero-build interactive dashboard. Coverage: 6,346 resolutions / 80,159 individual country votes (1946–2026); record count matches the collection total exactly, verified by three independent harvest methods. Version 1.1.0 (September 2026) adds the General Assembly's human rights resolutions — the texts that come out of the Third Committee — as a third organ behind a Bodies selector: 708 resolutions adopted by recorded vote (sessions 25–80, 1970–2025; 130,591 per-State plenary votes, from the UN Dag Hammarskjöld Library's General Assembly voting data v5), the Committee-stage roll-calls parsed from the Third Committee's summary records (747 recorded votes, 126,080 State votes, sessions 55–79; covering 438 of 446 draft-attributed resolutions; cross-checked against the Committee's e-voting sheets, 10,480 of 10,482 State-votes agree), committee-stage records for the Committee's 306 other votes (amendments, paragraphs, motions), a cross-organ title bridge to the Commission/Council texts, and 570 searchable A/RES texts from 1993. The Hugging Face package gains four ga_* configs.
